artifacts.role: Checksum-pinned source, fixtures, exact parity files and raw per-position counters
Per-file archive membership, lengths and hashes
Verified per-case state, occupancy and handshake totals
Position-level measured phase and operand-range counters
New simulation-only monitor, replay, analysis and protocol

correctness.reason: Exact archived events, BOS, cache and all phase counters in seven cases.

output_counts.reason: Identical frozen score and generated byte fixtures verified by the archived bench.

stage_cycles.reason: Disjoint controller partition and separate child state occupancy and handshakes.

correctness.evidence: Original seven exact score/output/BOS assertions and byte-identical AXI/BOS/KV/phase files.

limitations: Cycle breakdown refers to the frozen replay and simulated clocks. No new board timing, power or route is measured.
Child work can overlap and is not additive with the controller partition. Hypothetical savings require a new implementation check.
